headline_fix: Estimate and show total cost including shipping from step 1
working_well: Cart persists across sessions and devices
Card field switches to the numeric keyboard and accepts spaced input
could_not_assess: Screen reader pass on iOS; scheduled separately

findings.title: Shipping cost appears only at the final step
findings.evidence: 3 of 5 observed sessions abandoned at step 4 within seconds of the total updating; two participants said the price changed on them
findings.impact: abandonment, refund pressure, and a hidden-costs pattern with regulatory exposure
findings.fix: estimate shipping from postcode on step 1 and keep a running total visible on every step

findings.title: Marketing consent is pre-checked
findings.evidence: checkbox defaults to checked; under GDPR Article 7 this is not valid consent
findings.impact: invalid consent records for every EU order placed through this flow
findings.fix: default unchecked, one plain sentence on what the person gets

findings.title: Server errors clear the entered card details
findings.where: step 4, on any 4xx/5xx from the payment provider
findings.evidence: reproduced twice: a declined card returns 'Error 422' and empties every field on the step
findings.impact: re-entry burden at the highest-stakes moment; observed one rage-refresh
findings.fix: preserve all entered values, name the cause in plain words, keep focus on the failing field

findings.title: Card container padding is off the spacing scale
findings.evidence: 13px padding where the stylesheet's scale is 4px based; craft_lint flags it in 6 rules
